title: Story user-spec frontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for stories/**/user-spec.md. See process.md § Artifact ontology → user-spec.md for the full canonical structure.

title.description: Short human-readable Story title. Used in indexes and review tooling.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier matching the folder name under stories/.

items.description: Constitution rule slug this Story is subject to or enforces (e.g., 'no-passwords', 'tenant-isolation'). Must match a rule defined in constitution.md.

enforces.description: Constitution rules this Story touches. Used by /architect-review for cross-checking compliance.

items.description: Informational pointer to a code repository, service, or component touched by this Story (e.g., 'apps/web', 'services/auth').

affects.description: Code-perimeter touchpoints. Informational only; the master perimeter does not reach into these — it just notes them.
